name: Chaos Blood
source:
Komiya Soma is leading a casual university life, but one night he gets involved into strange case. A student girl stood naked on the rooftop, repeating meaningless words and eventually starting to pee. 
It was only the first of a series of incidents to arise in the future...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
小宫创真过着悠闲的大学生活，但有一天晚上他卷入了奇怪的案件。一名女学生赤身裸体站在屋顶上，重复着毫无意义的话，最后开始小便。
这只是未来发生的一系列事件中的第一个……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
